description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer Erase All checkpoint: safe Rust owns scrollback-aware ED 2 viewport advancement, physical-bottom clamping, viewport-relative cursor preservation and active standard-erase color fill.

entries.notes: Safe Rust implements the three Microsoft ED 2 scrollback cases: the viewport advances to the row after the pre-erase cursor when space remains, clamps at the physical buffer bottom, preserves prior rows as scrollback and reconstructs the cursor from its viewport-relative position.
Erase All keeps the cursor at the same viewport-relative row and column while the visible window advances into scrollback.
Erase All preserves the active rendition and fills every newly visible viewport cell with the active standard-erase colors, matching Microsoft's dark-red on bright-blue contract.
